verdict.rationale: Exporting account data and documents is a fair question for a registered-agent and business-filing service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing on data export, open formats, or account portability: the probe was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge, and the only community item is an off-topic remark about the company's SEO.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
